scope: 2,198 measure records in three Gapminder bulk collections. Records, not deduplicated metrics. No country-year cell audit or chart/software clearance.
method: Official metadata matching plus source-specific terms review. Supported means published terms support commercial display and data redistribution and no specific conflicting restriction was identified in the reviewed evidence. It is not a warranty of rights or a legal opinion. Unresolved is not a finding that use is prohibited.
default_policy: DENY unless exact record and commit appear in candidate list AND attribution, transformations, open-access delivery and implementation checks are complete. New indicators, commits and upstream terms need review.
limitations: Not a claim that every upstream national dataset has independently been legally cleared.
Source terms may differ by release, geography, and record. Conflicts have been held, not adjudicated.
Approved data rights do not clear maps/boundaries, software licences, original chart branding, full reports, photographs or logos.
Data files are identified through pinned manifests, not all downloaded or individually HTTP-tested.
Technical and legal assessment does not establish data accuracy, freshness or suitability for every use.
Attribution templates require developer completion, source links and actual modification descriptions before publication.
mandatory_attribution: Preserve original provider(s), World Bank where applicable, Gapminder, dataset/series title, source links, licence/terms links, snapshot date and actual changes. No endorsement claim. Do not apply blanket Enerqa all-rights-reserved terms to these data.

rules.finding: A compilation licence does not automatically clear every original provider. Review concerns numeric indicator data, not logos, reports, photos, software or every Gapminder chart.
rules.action: Preserve both original-provider and Gapminder attribution. Review a new release before enabling it.

rules.finding: Official per-series licence and dataset terms support commercial sharing and adaptation, subject to indicated third-party exceptions. No specific conflict was identified for Supported rows in this review.
rules.action: Retain the exact series code, source/provider credits, World Bank and Gapminder credit, licence link, snapshot date and modification notice.

rules.finding: CC BY 4.0 and CC BY 3.0 IGO permit commercial reuse and redistribution. Attribution, licence notices and change disclosure remain mandatory. Share-alike licences need separate treatment.
rules.action: Do not imply endorsement or impose restrictions on users that contradict the applicable licence.

rules.finding: Four WDI records carry CC BY-4.0 labels but their source references state CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO. A report licence may not be the data licence; the exact edition and redistribution grant remain unclear.
rules.action: Hold these specific records. Obtain written clarification or use a separately cleared data release.

rules.finding: EDGAR 2024 assigns CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 to IEA-EDGAR CO2, while WDI labels the affected series CC BY-4.0. CO2 and CO2-containing totals are held conservatively pending resolution.
rules.action: Resolve the exact rights for WDI redistribution. Do not infer that all EDGAR emissions have one licence.

rules.finding: EDGAR 2024 gives EU-owned material CC BY 4.0 and distinguishes the restricted IEA-EDGAR CO2 component. Methane, N2O and F-gas series do not contain that CO2 component.
rules.action: Credit EDGAR Community GHG Database, JRC and named contributors. Keep the exact release and change notice.

rules.finding: The current IEA Energy Statistics Data Browser page explicitly identifies CC BY 4.0. This does not clear other IEA products, including the restricted EDGAR 2024 CO2 input.
rules.action: Use only the specified open product and preserve IEA, World Bank and Gapminder credit. Offer open pinned data files rather than account-gated downloads.

rules.finding: The published free-use agreement is non-commercial. Gapminder or WDI CC BY labels do not resolve a conflicting original-provider grant.
rules.action: Do not publish or redistribute through Enerqa without applicable commercial and public-redistribution permission.

rules.finding: The free route does not establish commercial public-portal rights. Standard commercial access also limits redistribution.
rules.action: Exclude from the free-only launch. A bespoke written grant must cover public display, derivatives and downloadable data.

rules.finding: Commercial content use requires formal approval. Public access to the data is not a commercial redistribution licence.
rules.action: Hold until written permission covers the proposed public portal.

rules.finding: General terms restrict commercial benefit. A release-specific commercial grant for the GSoD version in Fast Track was not established.
rules.action: Seek the version-specific data licence or written permission; do not rely on the Gapminder output label alone.

rules.finding: Current data terms include a request for permission for potential commercial reuse, including data obtained through another party. This conflicts with relying solely on WDI CC BY labels.
rules.action: Hold IMF-sourced records until the intended commercial display and redistribution rights are confirmed.

rules.finding: Commercial data use requires authorisation and may require a royalty. The fair-use exception is not a blanket full-dataset portal licence.
rules.action: Obtain appropriate written permission or exclude.

rules.finding: ITU DataHub terms specify CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO. WDI CC BY labelling does not, by itself, resolve that source restriction.
rules.action: Hold pending a commercial redistribution grant applicable to the exact WDI or Gapminder release.

rules.finding: The public API documentation specifies a non-commercial licence. Its treatment in derived World Bank/UNHCR series requires clarification.
rules.action: Hold affected records until source and downstream rights are resolved.

rules.finding: The FishBase site specifies CC BY-NC 4.0 for its work. WDI threatened-fish counts are not automatically cleared by a CC BY label.
rules.action: Resolve the aggregate-series redistribution rights with the relevant provider.

rules.finding: A published IUCN agreement contains commercial-use restrictions. The current terms page could not be fully retrieved. No unrestricted grant for these WDI aggregates was confirmed.
rules.action: Keep held until the current, exact aggregate-data licence is established.

rules.finding: Current protected-area terms restrict commercial use and redistribution. Current merged-database terms are not conclusive for older WDPA aggregates, so those records remain unresolved.
rules.action: Confirm the exact historical WDI aggregate grant; do not republish boundary files on this basis.

rules.finding: General website/data terms do not supply an unrestricted commercial redistribution grant; commercial and promotional uses require care.
rules.action: Hold pending the specific indicator licence or permission.

rules.finding: Statistical database terms generally use CC BY 4.0 but also prohibit use in conjunction with promotion of a commercial enterprise, products or services. Third-party exceptions apply.
rules.action: Conditional for Enerqa: resolve applicability to the corporate portal and keep datasets independent of sales promotion. Do not assume removing a logo is sufficient.

rules.finding: Data terms generally permit CC BY 4.0 reuse but include a restriction on use in conjunction with promotion of a commercial enterprise, products or services. Publication terms may differ.
rules.action: Conditional for Enerqa: resolve the corporate/promotional context and the exact data release before activation.

rules.finding: Current data-browser terms use CC BY-SA 4.0. Commercial reuse is possible, but the share-alike condition is not equivalent to unrestricted CC BY.
rules.action: Confirm the applicable vintage and preserve share-alike where required, or obtain clarification of WDI-specific rights.

rules.finding: The ILO open-data grant applies to data and referential metadata published on or after 3 May 2023. Older releases are not automatically covered.
rules.action: Establish the source release date or replace with the corresponding post-3-May-2023 licensed series. A Git commit date is not proof of the original release date.

rules.finding: OECD data terms expressly allow commercial extraction, adaptation and redistribution, subject to third-party exceptions and attribution.
rules.action: Use OECD data attribution and change disclosure; the conclusion concerns the identified aid/ODA statistics, not every OECD publication.

rules.finding: UNdata permits copying and distribution with credit; UN Population Data Portal API documentation identifies CC BY 3.0 IGO. This does not clear unrelated historical inputs in Gapminder blends.
rules.action: Retain the original UN dataset/version and Gapminder credits. Do not extend this approval to mixed historical/projection series.

rules.finding: HDRO terms use CC BY 3.0 IGO and require proper attribution and attention to current versions.
rules.action: Retain index vintage; check freshness before publication and do not compare incompatible editions.

rules.finding: UNHCR dataset terms generally use CC BY 4.0. Third-party datasets such as IDMC require separate treatment.
rules.action: Retain UNHCR Refugee Population Statistics Database and Gapminder credit, terms link and date. This support applies to the direct refugee-series records identified here.

rules.finding: The National Carbon Emissions 2021 v1.0 metadata explicitly links an ICOS CC BY 4.0 data licence. The Fast Track documentation names this GCP release.
rules.action: Credit GCP, DOI 10.18160/GCP-2021, original sources and Gapminder; identify the historical release and transformations.

rules.finding: The Fast Track source sheet identifies Gapminder as producer of the Global Misunderstanding pilot survey and licenses data-output sheets CC BY 4.0.
rules.action: Credit Gapminder and the survey version. Do not present the pilot as a globally representative sample.

rules.finding: The current database is CC BY 4.0, but the Fast Track record refers to an older database/report combination. Exact historical release coverage remains to be confirmed.
rules.action: Use the current licensed database as a separately reviewed replacement or establish the historical source grant.

rules.finding: No complete, release-specific chain of commercial display and download rights was established. A missing licence is not evidence of a prohibition.
rules.action: Leave disabled. Obtain the source/version licence chain, including transformations, historical inputs and projections, before changing status.

rules.finding: The WDI record has a permissive label, but an exact source-specific commercial redistribution grant was not established for the identified specialist provider in this review.
rules.action: Verify the particular provider and release. Do not classify a generic label as permission for an entire third-party database.

rules.finding: A matching current WDI series exists, but this older transformed Systema record does not specify a sufficiently clear source edition for automatic transfer of clearance.
rules.action: Prefer the separately assessed WDI record; otherwise verify this exact Systema source vintage and transformations.
